in_sanskrit.name: नरेन्द्रसिंह
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who is the lord of mankind, the ruler of all beings, the protector of all beings, the king of all beings

in_marathi.name: Narendrasinh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of men
in_marathi.long_meaning: Narendrasinh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Narendra means 'Lord of men'. Sinh means 'lion'. Thus, Narendrasinh can be interpreted as 'Lord of lions' or 'Lion of the Lord'. This name is derived from the popular Hindu god Shiva, who is often depicted as a lion-headed deity.

in_bengali.name: Narendrasinh
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Lord of men
in_bengali.long_meaning: Narendrasinh একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Narendra means 'Lord of men'. Sinh means 'lion'. Thus, Narendrasinh can be interpreted as 'Lord of lions' or 'Lion of the Lord'. This name is derived from the popular Hindu god Shiva, who is often depicted as a lion-headed deity.
